ocrSourceEmphasis.answerSource: Retain exact answer-document text, ranges and locators as private source observations; never attach answer emphasis to same-text question content
ocrSourceEmphasis.mapping: original UTF-16 coordinates through validated editorial edits; reject mixed-boundary edits, unmatched source ranges and typography drift
ocrSourceEmphasis.optionMapping: Unique question locator, contiguous confirmed source order, complete literal stem and ordered labels/text; each range wholly inside one stem/option, never across labels or options; original UTF-16 coordinates through validated editorial edits
ocrSourceEmphasis.scope: Reading paragraphs, question stems and literal per-question options; Application Writing and Continuation Writing paragraphs; no table cells or inferred formatting
ocrSourceEmphasis.source: Agent-confirmed exact text ranges bound to immutable OCR page pixels and original source documents; no inferred styling

readingParagraphEmphasis.mapping: original UTF-16 coordinates through validated editorial edits; reject mixed-boundary edits and typography drift
readingParagraphEmphasis.scope: Reading paragraph text only; omit whole-paragraph decoration independently per property
readingParagraphEmphasis.source: direct DOCX run properties at the exact paragraph locator; no inferred or inherited styling

table.grid: columnStart and columnSpan cover every row exactly once after active rowSpan occupancy
table.mediaRef: mediaId resolves within the same canonical question group; alt is required literal text
table.rowSpan: integer >= 1; reserves every covered column in following rows and may not exceed the final row
